source: IS 875 (Part 2):1987 Clause 3.2 (reduction in imposed floor loads)

sources.floorCount.rows: IS 875 (Part 2):1987 Clause 3.2.1, Table 3: reduction of the imposed load on columns, piers, walls and foundations by the number of floors (including the roof) carried: 1 0 %, 2 10 %, 3 20 %, 4 30 %, 5-10 40 %, over 10 50 %
sources.floorCount.beamArea: IS 875 (Part 2):1987 Clause 3.2.2: a beam supporting at least 50 m² of floor at one level, 5 % for each 50 m², at most 25 %
sources.heavyLive: IS 875 (Part 2):1987 Clause 3.2.1: no reduction for loads due to storage and for factories and warehouses (SAEngine reads it as the uses in notReduced and floors over 5.0 kN/m²)
sources.kll: Not an IS 875 value: the floor-count rule has no live load element factor (all 1)
